chroma_key._comment: default-aroll.webm has a real brown backdrop, not a green screen, and no alpha channel, so RGB-distance color keying can't cleanly separate it from skin tones. method='segmentation' uses MediaPipe selfie segmentation (segmentation.py) to build a real per-frame person mask instead. Point foreground_video at real green-screen footage, set method='color' and threshold to ~60-90 to use classic chroma keying instead.
